name: dco-vendor-scorecard
description: Unified operations portal for a partner-operated GPU data center. It scores the IT and facility vendors against SLAs-as-code, checks their self-reported repairs against independent telemetry, and attributes faults across partners. Also includes a change-aware alarm board, incident portal, PIR, and weekly reviews. All data is synthetic.

paragraphs: Site operations for a partner-operated GPU data center, verified with independent telemetry instead of partner self-reporting.

▶ Open Unified Site Management, the live demo: scorecards and service credits for three partners, fleet availability, an alarm board, an incident portal, post-incident reviews with an Incident Commander runbook, a weekly operations review with a one-page leadership brief, a failure pattern review, PUE, GPU health, minute-by-minute telemetry for every device family with a site health dashboard, the Hall B rollout and Hall C readiness, the contracts with an ownership trainer, a glossary, and a device directory with an asset register, all built from one synthetic site and one set of contracts.
Portfolio demonstration. All data, parties, sites, and commercial terms are synthetic and fictional. Not affiliated with, or based on internal information from, any real company.

whatItDoes.text: Site operations for a partner-operated GPU data center, verified with independent telemetry instead of partner self-reporting.

requirements.text: The access itself is a contract term: Records access (RA-1 to RA-6) in both SLAs requires a read-only API account, the full record history and field edit log, and data no more than 15 minutes old.
